name: dsh-memory-rules
description: Local memory and standing rules for DeepSeek Harness — SQLite-backed four-layer memory (world facts, experiences, beliefs, standing answers) with structured fact extraction per turn, four-path retrieval (semantic/keyword/graph/timeline), 7-day belief consolidation, Markdown export, a pre-step recall hook, an editable set of system-prompt blocks carrying the user's hard collaboration rules (formerly the separate dsh-user-rules bundle), and a 记忆与规则 Web UI with 信念库 and 提示词 tabs.
author: 147-sys
